reply.text:
That sounds like a rough week, and I'm glad you said it out loud. I'm not going to hand you a fat-burning plan built on skipped meals. Under-eating tends to cost you training quality and muscle, and it makes the whole thing harder to stick with.

If skipping meals is tied up with how you feel about your body, that's worth talking through with a doctor or a dietitian. They can help in ways a coach can't.

On the training side, I can build you a solid program, and the app can set calorie and macro targets that include safe floors and a steady pace. If you tell me how many days a week you can train and what equipment you have, I'll get a program set up. Want to start there?
